picks.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to prove Riemann hypothesis, most famous problem in all of math
picks.rationale: The year's biggest AI-for-math event: Levent Alpöge announces a Claude-assisted proof of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis; same-day reports say independent checkers find it almost certainly correct.
picks.excerpt: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced an AI-generated (Claude-assisted) proof of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, long considered far out of reach for human mathematicians, capping AI's year-long run of math results.

picks.title: System of agentic AI for the discovery of metal-organic frameworks (MOFGen)
picks.rationale: Primary peer-reviewed paper with lab validation: an agent chain (LLM, diffusion, quantum-mechanical and synthesizability filters) generated hundreds of thousands of MOFs, and four were actually synthesized.
picks.excerpt: MOFGen chains an LLM that proposes MOF compositions, a diffusion model that generates crystal structures, quantum-mechanical filter agents and synthesizability agents; it generated hundreds of thousands of MOFs and four 'AI-dreamt' MOFs were successfully synthesized.

picks.title: New approach enables physically consistent AI models of chaotic systems
picks.rationale: Fixes a known failure of AI surrogates: MIT LIDS adds physics constraints that guarantee bounded long-run predictions for chaotic systems, relevant to turbulence, weather and climate emulators.
picks.excerpt: MIT LIDS researchers developed a physics-constrained machine learning approach that guarantees bounded predictions for chaotic systems, enabling reliable AI surrogates for turbulent flows, weather and climate modeling.

picks.title: Adaptive AI agent connects experimental planning with robotic control in wastewater treatment test
picks.rationale: Concrete closed-loop self-driving-lab result: UCL/HKUST(GZ)'s Embodied Science Agent ran 15 planner-robot rounds and lifted dye-removal transmittance from 82% to 99.7%.
picks.excerpt: UCL and HKUST(GZ)'s Embodied Science Agent pairs a Bayesian-optimization planner with an adaptive robot; over 15 closed-loop rounds of dye-removal experiments it raised solution transmittance from 82% to 99.7% (arXiv preprint).

picks.title: AI just solved the 'real' Navier-Stokes problem
picks.rationale: New AI-aided proof (Buckmaster/Alpöge) of Navier-Stokes blowup that closes the loophole critics found in OpenAI's September solution, a new result on the Millennium Prize problem.
picks.excerpt: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge claim a new AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup that closes the loophole critics found in OpenAI's September solution of the fluid-dynamics Millennium Prize problem.

https://www.scientificamerican.com/artic.new_action: A new, separate proof of Navier-Stokes blowup by Buckmaster (NYU) and Alpöge (Anthropic) that closes the loophole in OpenAI's September proof. It is a new result, not more coverage of the old one.
